description: This file contains test functions for a FastAPI-based application, utilizing pytest framework. It tests FastAPI endpoints by simulating HTTP requests and verifying response status codes, headers, content, and the OpenAPI schema. It also includes a fixture to initialize a test client configured with dynamically imported app modules.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on a parameter, creates and returns a TestClient instance for testing FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: test_path_operation(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that sends a GET request to '/legacy/' endpoint, asserting the correct status code, content-type header, and response text matching expected XML content.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that retrieves the OpenAPI schema from '/openapi.json' endpoint and verifies its correctness, including API info, version, paths, and response schemas.
